shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a three-column debug log in the Modern-suite spatial skin (verified in-game) that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them, with timestamps, HugsLib/Archotech add-on hosting, and log-spam throttling. Plus a knowledge-base browser, bug/fix reporting, dev actions + palette, impact scoring, mod-change detection, and a public v2 API. FOLDER CURRENTLY STRIPPED FOR 1.3 PUBLISH.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony. Open source (MIT). **Version constant `1.3`; v1.2 is live on the Workshop (3771602203).**

# ⚠ PUBLISH STATE (2026-08-16): FOLDER IS STRIPPED TO RUNTIME-ONLY
The mod folder currently contains ONLY: `About/ Assemblies/ Data/ Defs/ Languages/ Patches/(empty) Textures/ LICENSE .modmixer/`. **`Source/`, `Documentation/`, `_dev/`, `.git`, `.gitignore` are in the hold at `../_dev/2e197a8e6675/` with `RESTORE-MANIFEST.txt`.** Consequences until restored:
- **`build_mod` will FAIL** (no Source/). Do not attempt code changes.
- No git in the folder → the autosave task skips it (by design — prevents committing the stripped tree).
- `Assemblies/ModernDevTools.dll` is the **RELEASE** build (224 KB, optimized, DebugType none) of commit `d516545`, pushed to origin/main.
- Full pre-strip backup incl. `.git`: `D:/Rimworld/Modern Dev Tools/20260816-234233/`.
- **Restore protocol ("return to build mode"), only after the user confirms the upload:** move everything listed in the manifest back, then check `git status` — restored files showing `?? Source/` (untracked) would mean a stripped-state commit sneaked in (see distribution lore).

### Governing rule: everything shown is a factual claim
This mod tells players which mod broke their game and whether a mod changed. People act on it.
- **Fail closed.** When evidence is incomplete, say nothing and say *why*.
- **A match string must be provably reachable from `Log`** — and "emitted by identified code", NOT "present in Assembly-CSharp". A ubiquitous framework mod counts as an emitter (XML Extensions).
- **Never re-derive an identity you already held.** Record the name/id when you observe it.
- **Never rank ourselves as culprit for an error we only reported.**
- **Never search or sort by a string you do not display.**
- **Never show a raw internal identifier to the player.**

---

## Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`, gated on `LogWindowCompat.ModernOwnsLog`.

### Layout: three columns ("sidebar") + B1 suite reskin — **VERIFIED LIVE (run #245 + user sign-off "Tests good")**
Header + two toolbar rows replaced by: **LEFT sidebar 212px** (Bright title, `N shown · M hidden`, filter plate w/ dot+label+count where off = dimmed, Behaviour accent switches, Tools rows, amber mods-changed capsule pinned bottom) · **MIDDLE** (rounded search well w/ vanilla magnifier + focused accent ring, Copy all / Clear capsule pills, compat-hint strip, plateless culled list, ADD-ONS tray) · **RIGHT inspector** (panel2; stands down under 600px middle width; sidebar never drops). Close X top-right.

### B1 suite reskin details (built from `ModernDevTools-Log-Suite.html` study B1; tokens = Modern Health Tab / Colonist Bar)
- **Contrast hierarchy un-inverted**: `PageBG` #0A0C10 window base; `SidebarBG` #12161A (panel2: sidebar + inspector); `GroupBG` #191D21 (panel: plates/buttons/tray); `RowAlt` #20242A; `Ink` #06121F for text on accent. Semantic colours untouched — suite hex-parity holds. SidebarBG/GroupBG used only by the log window.
- `Spatial.Switch` on-colour Good→**Accent** (green reserved for health semantics; now agrees with settings toggles).
- **`Palette.SearchFieldFlat`**: chrome-less field core (old `SearchField` painted a square box+border over rounded plates — the most visible off-standard artifact). `SearchField` delegates to it; KB/dev-actions unchanged.
- Capsule pills: Copy all (accent) / Clear (softened red `Lerp(Bad,Bright,.35)`) / Dismiss (frosted white) / Ignore chip (RowAlt) / mods-changed (amber tint).
- List: RowH 28, BarH 30, **ts → dot → chip → text** column order, selected = RowAlt plate in 1px accent ring (two 9-slices, one row max), repeat chip idle bg RowAlt, sup chip `x12+395` honest form.
- Inspector order: **impact → type+time → message well → copy actions** → sections. `FilledButton` text = Ink. `PlainButton` hover = RowAlt.
- **Uppercase micro-headers** via cached `Micro()` (ToUpperInvariant; headers only; supersedes sentence-case FOR HEADERS — the suite signature; content never uppercased).
- Tray (`LogWidgets`): raised `Surface(GroupBG)` plate + cached ADD-ONS micro-label, `TrayHeight` 34.
- Strings: `MDT_TrayLabel` added; `MDT_HiddenSuffix` → `· {0} hidden`; dead `MDT_On`/`MDT_Off` pruned. **Keyed count 352.**
- Control counts per pass unchanged everywhere (each replaced button kept exactly one `ButtonInvisible`) — frame-latch discipline intact (`_hintVisible`/`_modsVisible` latched per `Time.frameCount`).

**Run #245 (isolated Core+DLCs):** all bridge captures were the mod's own synthetic test fixtures (glossary demo, repeat x5, burst) correctly attributed to us — attribution, repeat chips, and the skin exercised; user signed off ("Tests good"). This run also covered the **palette ghost-shadow fix (audit item 8) — now verified** per user sign-off.

### Timestamps (`LogTimestamps`, setting `showTimestamps`, default ON) — VERIFIED LIVE
`Verse.LogMessage` already carries a private `timestamp` string (`DateTime.Now.ToString("HH:mm:ss")` in both ctors). Bound once via `AccessTools.FieldRefAccess<LogMessage,string>` — no extra patch, pre-install lines still stamped; missing field ⇒ `Available` false, never an invented time. **Repeats keep the FIRST-seen time** (`LogMessageQueue.Enqueue` folds repeats) — UI says "first seen" when `repeats>1`. Surfaces: fixed-width first column (width from `"00:00:00"`), inspector type-header right label, `Logged:`/`First logged:` in `ReportBuilder.FullReport` (report ignores the display setting).

### Log-window ownership + interop
- **HugsLib** — `LogWidgets` reflects `LogWindowExtensions`' private `widgets`, rebinds `Drawer` via `Delegate.CreateDelegate`. Tray-hosted; throwing widgets dropped; `Any` frame-latched.
- **Archotech Logs** — `ArchotechBridge` hosts Diagnostics/Export; null host supported; mirrors `LogState.Selected` into the private static `EditWindow_Log.selectedMessage` via `SelectionChanged`.
- `yieldLogWindow` = full stand-down. Tray restyle: on-demand prefix on the 7-arg `Widgets.ButtonText`, gated on `LogWidgets.Drawing`, fails open.

### `LogThrottle` (default OFF) — VERIFIED LIVE (run #444: 400 interleaved → 5 shown + honest summary)
Engine builds the stack trace + disk-writes per repeat inside `lock(logLock)`; dedupe is consecutive-only. FNV-1a + 64-slot ring, threshold 5, 10s quiet reset, `Environment.TickCount`, own lock, fails open, latches off. Summaries drained from `Root.Update`. Test fixtures in `DebugActions_Testing.cs` ("Modern Dev Tools" category, prefix `[Modern Dev Tools test] ` — NOT LogPrefix, so they attribute to us). These ship as demos.

---

## Attribution pipeline
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext`; per-module `ContributeAttribution` then `Diagnose` in `def.order`; 13 modules in `Defs/ErrorModules.xml`; `RankedMods()` cached, invalidated by `Merge`. **`Frames` come from the CALLER's stack** (why self-report suppression exists).
- `Module_StackTrace` — frames→assembly; `NamespaceRoot` fallback only when exactly ONE mod declares the root; `FrameworkRoots` blocks IL-merged claims; **skips self when message starts with `ModernDevToolsMod.LogPrefix`** (every internal `Log.*` call must keep that prefix).
- `Module_LogPrefix` — `[ModName]` tags, unambiguous + ACTIVE only, strips Unity rich text first.
- `Module_MessageMentions` — three vanilla `Mod X …` grammars (GREEDY), packageId tokens, folders in paths.
- `Module_HarmonyPatches` — patched-method reverse index; conflict claim needs ≥2 foreign patchers or Harmony-routed trace.
- Plus `Module_DependencyCheck`, `Module_AboutIncompat`, `Module_VersionMismatch`, `Module_KnownIssues`, `Module_ModIssues`, `Module_CommunityBugs`, `Module_Community`, `Module_Glossary`, `Module_CircinusCorpus`, `Module_ReflectionBridge`.

### Diagnosis Score scale (house rule)
ModIssues 9+(n−i) > CommunityBugs 8+(n−i) > DependencyCheck 8–8.5 > AboutIncompat 7 > Community 6–7 > HarmonyPatches 4.5–6.5 > VersionMismatch 5 > KnownIssues n−i (benign +1000). Context-only modules < 1.

### `IssueScoring`
ONE matcher for the four knowledge surfaces (weights: ExceptionType 3 / Regex 3 / Keyword 2 / Namespace 2 / PackageId 2); allocation-free `OrdinalIgnoreCase`; `RegexOptions.Compiled` dropped in the shared compiler (Mono Reflection.Emit never reclaimed), FrameParser keeps it.

### Ignore keys — FIXED
`ErrorDiagnosis.Source` doubles as ignore key (KnownIssueDef defName / `MDT_Module_*` / `community:<id>`). `ModernDevToolsMod.IgnoredLabel(key)` resolves to a display label (KnownIssueDef → ErrorModuleDef → community → raw-in-tooltip); shared by `SettingsPage` + `Dialog_Modules`.

---

## Correctness audit — 2026-11 (runs #232/#444/#446/#447/#245) — headline results
1. **Mod-change detection REWRITTEN** (`ModFingerprint`+`ModChange`): FNV-1a 64 over sorted (relative path, file length) — no timestamps, so re-downloads/copies/restores can't fake "updated". Background thread, depth-cap 24, VCS/junk dirs excluded, 40k files budget; over-budget/unreadable ⇒ UNKNOWN never a guess. Keys `_steam`-normalized, local+Steam hashed together; display name recorded in the save; versioned nodes (`mdtModSnapshotV2`); "Updated" needs BOTH fingerprints; legacy pre-1.3 node read-only → `PresenceOnly` (structurally can't claim "updated"). Setting `detectModChanges` (on). Accepted limit: same-length edits invisible.
2. **Self-attribution FIXED** (run #232): Harmony finalizers appear in the trace of exceptions they report → we blamed ourselves for Vehicle Framework's bug. `Module_StackTrace` skips self on LogPrefix-prefixed messages.
3. **Third-party knowledge files scoped** — `RemoteIssue.OwnerPackageId`+`HasExplicitScope`; a shipped entry applies only when the error implicates its owner or it names its own ids/namespaces.
4. **`InstalledModIndex.Put()` prefers ACTIVE** (stale inactive copy could win keys → false version-mismatch).
5. **Greedy mod-name regexes** (4 sites) — lazy `(.+?)` truncated names.
6. **Phantom match strings purged / restored**: reachable-from-`Log` is the test; `MDT_Incompatible` removed; DependencyCheck `MissingRefSignals` rebuilt against verified call sites (real string: `"Failed to find <Type> named X. There are N defs..."` — confirmed live). XML Extensions' finalizer strings restored (ubiquitous framework mods count as emitters).
7. **Coverage adds**: UnknownType/DuplicateDef/MissingTexture/LoadReference keywords; rich-text stripping. Defs: KnownIssueDefs 42, BenignLogDefs 5, ErrorModules 13, community-bugs.json.gz 17.
8. **Ghost palette shadow FIXED + VERIFIED (run #245/user)**: `WindowStack` draws `drawShadow` BEFORE `WindowOnGUI` and ignores `onlyDrawInDevMode`; vanilla never closes dev windows when dev mode goes off. `Window_ModernDevPalette.drawShadow = false` (must stay false; every vanilla dev window sets it). Related trap: `ExtraOnGUI()` has no dev-mode gate either.

### Known-remaining, NOT fixed
- **Lunar Framework side-loading blindspot** (Map Preview / Geological Landforms) — fails silent, not wrong; any location-based fix needs REDUCED weight + own reason string (both ship `MapPreview.dll`).
- `Module_Community` `_steam`-suffix false negatives.
- `OrdinalIgnoreCase` vs engine `CurrentCultureIgnoreCase` Turkish-locale divergence (unverified).
- Two ACTIVE mods sharing a display name = coin flip in `ExactName`.
- `ModDependencyIndex` parity with `ModsConfig.FindConflicts` unverified.
- Uncovered grammars: `Parsed 1.5 as int.`, `[SafePatcher]…`, texture/mask dimension mismatch, `has no resolvedGrains`.

---

## Shared UI (`Palette` + `Spatial`)
Dark suite chrome; sentence case (uppercase = micro-headers only); cached `Theme.Accent` (ModernNotifications reflection, #73BFFF fallback); flat gray scrollbars; `GameFont.Tiny` banned except the palette category line; icons `MdtTex` + `Verse.TexButton.Search`. Helpers: `SearchField`/**`SearchFieldFlat`**, `ToggleRow`, `DrawCard/Well/Plate`, `SectionHeader`, `DrawToggle`, `DrawCheck`, `ModuleRow`, `GrayButton`, `StateStrip`, `LabelFit`, `BeginScroll`/`EndScroll`/`ResetGuiState`.
- Never scale text with `GUI.matrix`; size rects from `Text.LineHeightOf`.
- `DrawPlate` fast path gated to UIScale 1.0 (*unverified at 125/150%*).
- `BeginScroll` re-entrant (skin STACK); all sites try/finally; `ResetGuiState()` unwinds strays.

### `Spatial` (ported from Modern Needs Tab)
9-slice rounded surfaces via `Widgets.DrawAtlas`, one generated texture per shape, no shipped art. `Capsule(22)/Surface(18)/RowPlate(10)/Pill/Dot(1 quad)/Elevate/TopHighlight/Separator/Switch(accent-on)/Badge`. `Ensure()` re-validates per call (destroyed-texture `== null` after `MemoryUtility.UnloadUnusedUnityAssets()` on new game/save load/menu return; `HideAndDontSave` + static fields + revalidation — same lesson as the scrollbar fix, which is verified live). **Cost rule: 9-slice = NINE draws ⇒ surfaces only; per-row = Dot/plain rects.**
Palette neutrals (semantics untouched): `Bright`, `PageBG` #0A0C10, `SidebarBG` #12161A, `GroupBG` #191D21, `SwitchOff`, `Sep`, `TextFaint`, `Ink` #06121F.

### Performance
- **Big-modlist lag FIXED** (uncached `GenText.Truncate` measure-loops): `TextMetrics.Fit` memoised binary-search ellipsis; routed through `Palette.LabelFit`, `Window_ModernDevPalette.LabelCategory`, `Window_ModernDevActions.DrawCell`; `FirstLine` per-message `ConditionalWeakTable`. *Not yet re-verified on a real 1000-mod log.*
- `TextMetrics`: memoised CalcHeight/CalcSize/Fit keyed on (text, width, coerced font, fontSize, wrap); cap-then-clear 8192; main thread only.
- Not yet addressed: dev-actions list view has no culling; `DebugTree.Children()` re-runs delegates + allocates per pass; inspector draws the full trace through one Label; planned "UI cost probe".

## Tool 4: knowledge base (`Window_KnowledgeBase`)
8 categories, searchable, provenance-cited, viewport-culled w/ frame-latched window; counts cached. **Still pre-B1 skin — candidate for the same bridge next.**

## Tools 2/3: dev actions + palette
`Window_ModernDevActions` (3-tab, vanilla node graph, icon-grid spawn pickers, BFS search; display-label search/sort fix incl. squashed matching + icon fallback — Medieval Overhaul field notes stand). `Window_ModernDevPalette` (nodes cached on palette hash; `_pendingResizeFrame` a LATER frame; **`drawShadow` stays false**). Both pre-B1 skin.

## Hardening + `HardeningPatches`
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening`, off by default; patches install only while on. **One permanent patch: `Root.Update` postfix** → `SyncIfNeeded()` + `LogThrottle.DrainSummaries()` + `ModChange.TickPending()`; never apply from settings UI. `_broken` latch. Verified live (run #232).

## Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Background fetch, cached, offline fallback (`Data/community-bugs.json.gz` — **runtime file, ships**). RimSort Community Rules + Use This Instead + our known-issues.json. `LogAnalysisCache.Clear()` via volatile `_dirty`.

## Public API v2 (`ModernDevToolsAPI`) — frozen
`ApiVersion = 2`: `RegisterModule`, `Invalidate`, `RegisterKnowledgeSource`, `RegisterLogWidget`, `AnalysisCompleted`, `ModernOwnsLogWindow`, `IsModernLogOpen`, `OpenModernLog()`, `YieldLogWindow()`. `LogWidgetDrawer` signature-identical to HugsLib's. No signature changed in 1.3.

## Settings surfaces — parity contract
`SettingsPage.Draw` canonical superset; `Dialog_Modules` quick subset. Cards: Log window (`showTimestamps`, `yieldLogWindow`), Log spam (`Throttle repeating log lines`), General (`Detect mods changed since a save`), Modules, Ignored, Community, Experimental hardening. `Documentation/UI-Parity.md` (in hold during publish).

## Design mockups (in hold during publish: `../_dev/2e197a8e6675/_dev/`)
- `ModernDevTools-Log-Suite.html` — five interactive suite-standard studies; **B1 picked, built, verified**. B2 (triage roster) and B5 ("Why this ranking" score card) are the strongest future candidates.
- `refs/std-ref-1/2.png` — the suite-standard target screenshots; `ModernDevTools-Log-iOS.html` — superseded iOS round; `refs/shot1-3.png` — Apple refs.
- Stray `Mods/_dev/ModernHealthTab/ModernHealthTab-TL-Spatial-B.html` still awaiting keep/delete (unrelated to this mod's hold).

## Docs (canonical, outside the mod): `workspace/_dev/ModernDevTools/`
- **`FIELD_MANUAL.md` — UPDATED for 1.3** (three-column layout + suite look, timestamps, throttle chip semantics, add-on tray/interop, fingerprint rewrite in §9, settings table now includes Show timestamps / Throttle / Detect mods changed / Use the vanilla log window, HugsLib/Archotech compat notes). Backup `FIELD_MANUAL.md.bak-20260816-234123` alongside.
- `STEAM_DESCRIPTION.txt` — **NOT touched** (user-owned; pending their decision on mentioning 1.3 features; remember: fetch the LIVE page first if it gets rewritten).
- `community-db/` — regenerated known-issues.json still awaiting the user's push to `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues`.
- `_shipfolder-dev-20260725-201450/` — the 1.2 publish hold (historical).

## Testing / environment notes
- ReShade (`dxgi.dll`) causes silent crashes, not the mod. Run #232: ~910-mod list, one attributed error = ours-by-report (fix #2). Runs #444/#446: scrollbar, timestamps, throttle confirmed. Run #447: ghost-shadow report. **Run #245: B1 skin + fixtures + shadow fix — user sign-off.** Note (lore): the user tests outside Modmixer too; my run log is an incomplete record.

## 1.3 RELEASE — READY, AWAITING UPLOAD
- Version `1.3`; supportedVersions `1.6`; PublishedFileId `3771602203` (upload = UPDATE); `About/Preview.png` present; About.xml has `<url>` to the public repo; LICENSE (no extension) ships.
- **352 keyed strings** (added `MDT_TrayLabel`; pruned dead `MDT_On`/`MDT_Off`). `MDT_UpdateNotesBody` now covers: redesigned window + suite look, timestamps, throttle, big-modlist perf fix, interop, accuracy fixes, API.
- Release DLL built from commit **`d516545`**, pushed to origin/main. D: backup `D:/Rimworld/Modern Dev Tools/20260816-234233/`. Folder stripped + verified (no cs/csproj/md/html/pdb/ps1/0Harmony).

### User actions to finish 1.3
1. **Upload via Modmixer's publish utility** (folder is ready as it sits).
2. Description/change notes: the uploader does not update an existing item's description — paste via the **Steam web editor** (and remember it strips nothing here since that's the web path; the ◆-stripping applies only to the uploader-create path).
3. Decide whether the Workshop description should mention 1.3's timestamps/new layout (STEAM_DESCRIPTION.txt + About.xml `<description>` kept in lockstep if so; fetch the live page first).
4. **Push `community-db` known-issues.json** to `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues` (or the opt-in fetch keeps overwriting good local data).
5. Then say **"return to build mode"** — I restore from the manifest and verify git.

### Still unverified (post-1.3 backlog)
`TextMetrics.Fit` on a real big-modlist log; mod-change panel end-to-end + `ModFingerprint` cost on ~910 mods; v2 snapshot Scribe round-trip; `PresenceOnly` legacy path; mod-shipped-issue scoping; tray restyle + Archotech tray buttons with real HugsLib present; `DrawPlate`/Spatial corners at 125/150% UI scale; `IgnoredLabel` fallback; Turkish-locale matcher divergence.
